title: Rust and Roses
description: Original straight-eighth classic rock in G major at 118 BPM where distorted sawtooth synths stand in for the rhythm and lead guitars (Studio has no guitar or audio samples) trading riff calls and answers with a square-and-sine organ-style keys part, arranged as intro, two verse-to-chorus cycles (first with a pre-chorus), a guitar-style solo, an organ breakdown, a final chorus and an outro.
